source: Independent reference implementation (a Python script, not the module under test) over the raw bars of the fixture below, from the conventions CLIENT.md 11.6 states. CLIENT.md 11.6 names yahoo-chart-AAPL-max-1d.json as the study-golden capture; that capture is QUARTERLY (docs/TESTING.md L748), so a study whose parameters are periods would be labelled 'daily' and computed on quarters. The daily capture is used instead and the deviation is recorded here.
